content.comment_body: I want to connect a 1024-pulse encoder to [product_name] [version_no]. I'm not sure which models support this. I currently have two units, but none seem to feature fast digital inputs. The encoder uses 24V and will operate at up to 200RPM. Best regards, [user_name].
[product_name] [version_no] provides fast input functionality using models such as: - [article_no] 12/24 RCE - [article_no] 24 CE
Thanks for your response. I would like to confirm that connecting signal A+ to I4 (for Up/Down counter), B+ to I5 (for direction), and Z+ to I6 (for resetting the counter) is the correct setup?
I'm not certain about this, as I don't typically work with encoders in [product_name].

Encoders using A/B signals are generally not compatible with [product_name] controllers. Some users have experimented with this—try searching for 'encoder' in the forum archives. However, you may not obtain precise position readings. The fast counter input only delivers high speed if the signal is wired to the clk input; the direction input is asynchronous. Regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: There is uncertainty among users regarding which [product_name] [version_no] variants support fast digital inputs for a 1024-pulse encoder. While certain models offer fast input capabilities, users are uncertain about correct setup procedures and compatibility, particularly for accurate position feedback. The discussion points out challenges with documentation and product information regarding encoder integration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks clear advice on which [product_name] [version_no] model offers fast digital inputs compatible with their encoder, along with step-by-step instructions for proper wiring and configuration.
